title: [Review][Research] Splurge-Worthy Face Creams (ranked from most to least transformative)
text:
I’ve been fortunate to try some amazing brands through a friend who works at Vogue (ex-Allure) and my skincare-obsessed mom. While I haven't used all of these long enough to see significant results, I gathered insights from my friend and did some quick research on overall ratings and reviews.

My friend told me to make it a point to state that these brands heavily invest in R&D to develop unique ingredients and innovative formulas, which helps justify their prices so I included if the brand is founded buy a scientist and if they have any R&D-backed ingredient. 

Below are my top six products, ranked from most to least transformative, along with a few honorable mentions under and over $200 to accommodate different budgets.

* **La Mer Crème de la Mer** ($200 for 1 oz, $390 for 2 oz)
   * Founder: late Scientist Dr. Max Huber (parent company: Estée Lauder Companies)
   * Key Ingredient: "Miracle Broth" (fermented kelp) for intense hydration and skin healing  (he suffered a lab injury and he took 12 years to develop this miracle skin renewing formulation)
   * Transformative Aspects: deeply hydrates and soothes skin, renowned for its calming effects  
   * Other Actives: glycerin, mineral oil, and various antioxidants  
   * Purpose: intense hydration and repair for dry skin  
   * Ideal For: very dry or sensitive skin  
   * Reviews: "holy grail" moisturizer, "the ultimate moisturizer", lauding its transformative effects on very dry skin, its calming properties, significant improvements in skin texture and hydration, worth the steep price
   * Celebrity Users: Beyoncé, Kim Kardashian, Jennifer Lopez
* **Augustinus Bader The Rich Cream** ($290 for 1.7 oz)
   * Founder: Scientist & Professor Augustinus Bader (no parent company)  
   * Key Ingredient: TFC8 (Trigger Factor Complex) for cell renewal  
   * Transformative Aspects: supports skin regeneration and hydration  
   * Other Actives: amino acids, vitamins, and other natural ingredients  
   * Purpose: anti-aging and rejuvenation  
   * Ideal For: all skin types, especially mature  
   * Reviews: "miracle cream" for quick results, "everyday miracle", transforming skin texture and hydration, praised for its ability to restore and rejuvenate the skin, visible reduction in fine lines, improved elasticity
   * Celebrity Users: Demi Moore, Victoria Beckham, Angela Basset
* **La Prairie Skin Caviar Luxe Cream** ($555 for 1.7 oz) 
   * Founder: Swiss Physician Dr. Thierry Hugo (parent company: La Prairie Group)
   * Key Ingredient: caviar extract for firming and radiance  
   * Transformative Aspects: renowned for its luxurious texture and anti-aging properties  
   * Other Actives: peptides and antioxidants  
   * Purpose: anti-aging and radiance  
   * Ideal For: mature skin  
   * Reviews: "go-to anti-aging cream", "The Luxe Anti-Aging Wonder", recognized for luxurious texture and immediate lifting effects, very visible lifting effects, raved ability to provide a radiant glow and youthful firmness
   * Celebrity Users: Anne Hathaway, Naomi Watts, Joan Collins
* **Clé de Peau Beauté La Crème** ($550 for 1 oz)
   * Founder: team of Scientists and Doctors from Shiseido (parent company: Shiseido Company)
   * Key Ingredient: Illuminating Complex EX for enhancing radiance
   * Transformative Aspects: enhances texture and overall skin appearance  
   * Other Actives: various botanical extracts  
   * Purpose: Radiance and hydration
   * Ideal For: all skin types  
   * Reviews: "indulgent treat for the skin", "unparalleled hydration", smooth finish, luxurious texture and results, enhances skin radiance and overall texture
   * Celebrity Users: Lupita Nyong'o, Michelle Yeoh, Amanda Seyfried
* **SK-II R.N.A. Power Radical New Age Cream** ($235 for 2.7 oz)
   * Founder: Scientists from Procter & Gamble (parent company: Procter & Gamble)  
   * Key Ingredient: Pitera for cell renewal  
   * Transformative Aspects: enhances elasticity and promotes youthful skin  
   * Other Actives: peptides and glycerin  
   * Purpose: anti-aging and hydration  
   * Ideal For: all skin types, particularly aging skin  
   * Reviews: "secret weapon" for youthful skin, "wrinkle eraser", ability to dramatically improve skin firmness and elasticity, effectiveness in improving skin texture, visible reduction in the appearance of wrinkles after consistent use
   * Celebrity Users: Cate Blanchett, Naomi Osaka, Zendaya 
* **Dr. Barbara Sturm Super Anti-Aging Face Cream** ($365 for 1.7 oz)
   * Founder: Dr. Barbara Sturm (no parent company)  
   * Key Ingredient: Powerful antioxidants for skin protection  
   * Transformative Aspects: Reduces signs of aging while hydrating  
   * Other Actives: Hyaluronic acid and purslane  
   * Purpose: Anti-aging and hydration  
   * Ideal For: Mature and sensitive skin  
   * Reviews: "powerhouse age-defier", "soothing anti-aging hero", "spa like experience", significant hydration, luxurious feel, effectiveness, reduction in the appearance of fine lines, its calming properties for sensitive skin
   * Celebrity Users: Hailey Bieber, Karlie Kloss, Naomi Campbell
